xref.title: Live 8 Performance - Philadelphia
xref.body: Coldplay was one of the many artists and celebrities who appeared at the Live 8 global telecast benefit concert on July 2nd, 2005. "You too, audio, life, green day, Roxy music, James Brown, Nelson Mandela, Bill Gates, Brad Pitt, David Beckham, Ricky Gervais, Coldplay, Madonna, REM, the killer, Sting, the cure, Lincoln Park, Sarah McLaughlin, Will Smith, and Durand Durand, and a whole bunch of others."
